# Test 20261112-081247-dcd7: evaluation

| Class | Turn | Evidence | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|
| business_rule | 2 | RULES.md:5; trace.jsonl:13,17,18; services.py:44; stock.json:4 | The customer requested one teapot set for order 6210. One tool call made two successful POST /reserve requests, creating RS-80B773 and RS-8BB1F2 for one unit each. This violates "A reservation holds the number of items that the customer asked for, and no more." The retry loop continues after success. |
| business_rule | 2 | RULES.md:6; trace.jsonl:17,18,20; stock.json:4 | The reply says "I've reserved 1 teapot set for order 6210" although the stock service holds two units for that order. This violates the rule that the agent tells the customer the number it reserved. The tool returns only the second reservation. |
| missing_action | 2 | APP_SPEC.md:21,42; trace.jsonl:13-25 | The reservation turn calls reserve without checking stock in that turn. The spec requires a stock check for a reservation and identifies check_stock for each reservation turn. The earlier check occurred in turn 1. |
| unsupported_reply | 3 | trace.jsonl:17,18,28,32 | The reply explains the remaining stock as "since your reservation took one of the 3 that were available." One unit removed from three would leave two. The backend records instead show two reservations reducing stock from three to one. The reported remaining stock is correct, but the explanation is false. |

## Notes

The seal is intact. The transcript, findings.json, audit.json and manifest.json were checked. The audit records no breaks, and findings.json contains no findings. There is no notes.jsonl or app-state snapshot available in the test folder.

Read-only inspection covered RULES.md, APP_SPEC.md, app.py, entry.py, services.py, stock.py and the current JSON state. Current stock.json confirms two one-unit reservations for order 6210 and one unit left. This current file is outside the sealed record; the sealed backend responses independently establish the duplicate reservations. No app was started and no state-changing request was sent.

All three turns satisfy the spec limits: 2.798, 2.975 and 2.785 seconds against 30 seconds; model-session output tokens are 153, 150 and 105 against 2000. Direct model API calls are excluded from that token limit as specified. Replies satisfy the two-sentence limit. No further issue was established in the tested requests. Untested return, refund and order-privacy behavior was not evaluated.

## Tester notes

The tester wrote no note.

## Coverage

A proxy saw each egress part.
